description: Implement and execute a cheap body-only MuJoCo replay from the same saved physical state; first reproduce the historical sham qpos/qvel, then apply zero and mirrored fixed steering. Do not call it a biological organism intervention.

Independently review primary Yang 2024 and Rayshubskiy 2025 studies to test whether DNb05 validates a specific tanh decoder and whether DNa02 can be dismissed from odor-driven walking. Compare Buchanan 2015 handedness to a single model sham trajectory.

Extend the existing in-kernel FP64 direct output tap to the actual DNb05 pair without adding Python calculations inside the hot neural step; verify on/off state identity and signed target reconstruction.

Design a frozen matched causal experiment that disables only the left PN 629-general-output substitution while retaining its 466 dynamic destinations and each hemisphere's own connectome, with four odor arms and a numerical gate.
